learning: Iteration 6 showed that wheel_radius 0.04 m brings back line loss and lowers s-bend progress, so speed is not a free lever. Slalom oscillation stayed near 0.14 across leads y=0.05 to 0.07 m, so it is not lead-driven. If oscillation stays above 0.10 with zero line loss after this race, the controller (kd or kp) is the next lever, not geometry. Slalom max_error is the key number for the spread change.
notes: Integrator package implementing the Builder's combined change from iteration 3: sensor row y=0.065 m (from 0.07 m), spread widened to ±0.065 m, footprint kept at 16 mm, wheel_radius kept at 0.03 m. The controller is unchanged from iteration 3, so the race isolates geometry.
rationale: Iteration 3 (y=0.07 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, 51.31) is the best raced design. Iteration 6 showed that wheel_radius 0.04 m brings back line loss and cuts s-bend progress to 0.1325, so ground speed should stay at 0.03 m. Iteration 4 (y=0.06 m) and iteration 5 (y=0.05 m) showed that the forward lead is needed for s-bend progress, but y=0.07 m also gave one line-loss event per run on s-bend and slalom. Slalom steering_oscillation stayed near 0.13 to 0.14 at every lead tested (y=0.05, 0.06, 0.07 m), so the lead does not cause it. Slalom max_error was 0.065 to 0.069 m at the ±0.05 m spread, above the 0.06 m off-track limit. The Builder's plan applies the agreed rules: keep wheel_radius at 0.03 m, set sensor y to 0.065 m to keep most of the lead while cutting speed-related line loss, and widen the spread to ±0.065 m with 16 mm footprints so the line stays under the sensors on slalom bends. I take the Builder's geometry as written. The controller stays at the iteration 3 settings (kp 2.0, ki 0, kd 0.10, base_speed 1.6, last_direction) with weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], so the signal stays within about ±2 across the wider spread. Changing both the lead and the spread at once makes attribution harder. The observation request therefore reports per-track line_loss_events, max_error and steering_oscillation so each change can be read separately. Expected result: line loss back to 0, s-bend progress near 0.14 to 0.155, slalom max_error below 0.06 m, and a score of about 50 to 54. The oval should stay at progress 0.1125 and max_error about 0.060 m. Risk: a wider spread can reduce signal resolution near centre.
